=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:3576-3600 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The last run raised `HEAL_SCOPE_LINKED_PATHS_MAX` from 8 to 20 and deleted the comment explaining the sub-cap. Linked paths are merged into `self_workflows`, which becomes `workflow_paths`, and `render_heal_scope_marker` places those ahead of `subjects[:HEAL_SCOPE_SUBJECT_RESERVE]` and `changed_files`, so linked paths can fill all 20 explicit slots.
  WHY: A release heal with several linked runs can drop every failing-test subject (`heal_scope_truncated`). The plan gate then refuses the plan with `heal_scope_plan_out_of_scope`, which repeats the #6907/#6916 regression. The issue only asks that the added paths "count toward the existing 20-path cap". All reviewers rated this MAJOR.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:7205-7396 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In `heal_scope_linked_workflow_paths`, the check `if len(paths) >= HEAL_SCOPE_LINKED_SCRIPTS_PER_STEP: break` compares the cap with the run's running total of paths (own workflow + callees + earlier step scripts), not with the scripts in the current step. Scripts dropped at that break get no `skipped`/`cap_reached` entry.
  WHY: A wrapper with several callees silently loses step scripts, and operators see no diagnostic in the `scope_linked` skip reasons. `test_scripts_per_step_are_capped` pins the per-run behaviour. Severity disagreement: gemini rated it MAJOR; sonnet, minimax and glm rated it NIT. The highest rating is used here.
- tests/test_promote_main_cycle.py:14-22 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: A module-wide autouse fixture `_executable_temp_root` sets `tempfile.tempdir` to `REPO_ROOT`. This sends all of the module's TemporaryDirectory calls (69 call sites) into the repository root, as a sandbox workaround unrelated to #8360.
  WHY: Killed or crashed runs leave `tmp*` directories in the checkout, which pollutes repo-tree, inventory and clean-tree checks and makes the tests depend on the repo root being writable and executable. The pre-push gate lists 10 tests in this file under "Failures caused by this change". All reviewers rated this MAJOR.
- tests/test_review_semble_contract.py:457-461 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The last run added a silent inline JSONL fallback for when `tests/fixtures/review_pipeline/opencode-reviewer-events.jsonl` is missing. The change is unrelated to #8360.
  WHY: The contract test passes against its embedded copy even if the fixture is deleted or drifts, so a missing fixture no longer fails CI. Reviewers disagree on whether the fixture exists: sonnet says it is absent from the checkout, while minimax and glm say it is committed. All rated this NIT.
- PR DESCRIPTION:"Closes https://github.com/shubhodeep1/coding-workflows/issues/8360" | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The PR description uses the auto-close keyword "Closes" for issue #8360, which gemini says is an orchestrator-tracking issue.
  WHY: Merging would auto-close #8360 and stop the orchestrator state machine, which violates §21 (rated BLOCKER). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash explicitly rejected this claim: they say #8360 is a sub-issue or ordinary pipeline issue, not `ai:orchestrator-tracking`.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:line 3579 `HEAL_SCOPE_LINKED_PATHS_MAX = 20`; line 3593 `ordered = [crash_file, *workflow_paths, *subjects[:HEAL_SCOPE_SUBJECT_RESERVE], *changed_files, ...]`; line 3600 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The cap was raised from 8 to 20 and its rationale comment deleted. Linked paths in `workflow_paths` come ahead of the reserved subjects, so they can fill all 20 slots.
  WHY: Failing-test subjects get dropped (`heal_scope_truncated`) and the plan is refused with `heal_scope_plan_out_of_scope`, the #6907/#6916 regression. Fix: restore a sub-cap (`20 - HEAL_SCOPE_SUBJECT_RESERVE` or 8), update the test constants and keep the comment.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:line 7391 in `heal_scope_linked_workflow_paths`; line 7208 `HEAL_SCOPE_LINKED_SCRIPTS_PER_STEP = 20` | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The per-step limit is compared with the run's running total of paths, and dropped scripts get no `skipped` entry.
  WHY: A wrapper with callees gets fewer step scripts, with no `cap_reached` reason. Fix: count per-step scripts and call `_skip("cap_reached")` on break.
- tests/test_promote_main_cycle.py:lines 20-22 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: An autouse fixture sends all tempfile directories (69 call sites) into the repo root. It is unrelated to #8360, and the pre-push gate now lists 10 tests under "Failures caused by this change".
  WHY: Killed runs (e.g. at the 120s `subprocess.run` timeout) leave `tmp*` dirs in the worktree, and the tests now depend on the repo root being writable and executable. Fix: revert the fixture and the unused `import pytest`.
- tests/test_review_semble_contract.py:lines 457-461 (fixture const lines 28-30) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Silent inline fallback for a missing `opencode-reviewer-events.jsonl`, which the reviewer reports as not in the checkout. Unrelated to #8360.
  WHY: The test passes against its embedded copy whether the fixture is deleted or drifted. Fix: commit the fixture or drop the fallback.
- Notes: rejected the "Closes #8360 is orchestrator-tracking" finding (#8360 is not tracking-labelled; §21 permits auto-close). The `orchestrate-poll (1)` CI cancellation at `timeout-minutes: 20` (`.github/workflows/ci.yml` line 2251) is unrelated and a flake. The intake replay failures come from a local environment missing PyYAML/jq; `tests-heal-plan-and-validation` passed.
- HARDENING: scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py heal_scope_linked_workflow_paths step-script loop (line 7391): track per-step count and call `_skip("cap_reached")` before `break` (~3 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
